JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene

payload.content: Hi all — Raylene here. My skill match is backend:0.85, so my costs are far lower on the ISSUE-0002 (backend) tasks than on ISSUE-0001 (infrastructure). My best options: ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.90), ISSUE-0002::test (2.66), ISSUE-0002::implement (3.80). I plan to claim ISSUE-0002::review. If someone else has a stronger/cheaper claim on review, tell me and I'll shift to test or implement instead. Please avoid duplicating ISSUE-0002::review.

Proposed split to maximize covered tasks while respecting skills: I take ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 1.90). Recommend others grab the remaining higher-priority ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement/test) if your skill matches, then the low-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks. Reply with your intended claim so we can deconflict before execution.

Maya here. Skills: mobile-development:0.77, api-development:0.64, so I match ISSUE-0002 (mobile/backend) better than ISSUE-0001 (infrastructure). Given Raylene takes ISSUE-0002::review, I plan to claim ISSUE-0002::test (medium priority). Gerda / Mackenzie: please consider ISSUE-0002::implement and the ISSUE-0001 low-priority tasks so we cover all 3 medium tasks + 1 low task without duplicates. If anyone has a clearly cheaper claim on ISSUE-0002::test, say so and I'll shift (I can also take ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage). Reply with your intended claim. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Raylene here, confirming my plan: I'll claim ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 1.90 — clearly my cheapest and a strong backend match). Maya is on ISSUE-0002::test. That leaves ISSUE-0002::implement (medium) and the ISSUE-0001 low-priority tasks for Gerda and Mackenzie. Gerda / Mackenzie — please reply with your intended claims so we get 3 medium + 1 low with no duplicates. If either of you has a cheaper claim on ISSUE-0002::review than 1.90, say so and I'll switch to implement/test. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Maya here, confirming my final plan for execution: I will claim ISSUE-0002::test (medium, my cost 2.89, mobile-development match). Raylene = ISSUE-0002::review. That covers 2 of the 3 medium tasks with no duplicate. Gerda & Mackenzie: please claim ISSUE-0002::implement (medium) and one ISSUE-0001 low task (review/docs/triage) so we cover all 3 medium + 1 low. If either of you is cheaper on ISSUE-0002::test, say so now and I'll shift to an ISSUE-0001 api-development task. (phase=planning)

Mackenzie here. My skill is mobile-development:0.62, so I'm matched to ISSUE-0002. My private costs: ISSUE-0002::review=2.44, ::test=3.42, ::implement=4.88; all ISSUE-0001 tasks cost me 10.00+.

Deconfliction: Raylene is cheaper on review (1.90<2.44), Maya is cheaper on test (2.89<3.42). So I will claim ISSUE-0002::implement (medium). This covers the 3rd medium task with no duplicates. Gerda: please take an ISSUE-0001 low task (review/docs/triage) to avoid clashing on implement. If Gerda has a cheaper claim on implement, tell me and I'll shift to a low task.

Raylene here — plan is deconflicted and confirmed. Final: Raylene = ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.90), Maya = ISSUE-0002::test, Mackenzie = ISSUE-0002::implement, Gerda = one ISSUE-0001 low task (review/docs/triage). This covers all 3 medium tasks + 1 low with no duplicates. Gerda, please confirm your low-priority pick so we have no collisions. I'll commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Maya here — final confirmation. Plan is deconflicted: Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Maya=ISSUE-0002::test (my cost 2.89, mobile-development match), Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::implement, Gerda=one ISSUE-0001 low task (review/docs/triage). This covers all 3 medium tasks + 1 low with no duplicates. I will commit ISSUE-0002::test in execution. Gerda, please confirm your low-priority pick to avoid collisions.

Mackenzie final confirmation: I will commit ISSUE-0002::implement (medium, my cost 4.88, my cheapest medium task). Plan: Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Maya=ISSUE-0002::test, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::implement, Gerda=one ISSUE-0001 low task. No duplicates from me. Gerda, please confirm your low-priority pick (review/docs/triage) to avoid collisions.

Raylene final: locking in ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.90, backend match). Plan confirmed: Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Maya=ISSUE-0002::test, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::implement, Gerda=one ISSUE-0001 low task. No duplicates from me. Committing in execution.

Mackenzie final lock-in: I will claim ISSUE-0002::implement (medium, effort 2.0, my cost 4.88 — my cheapest medium task and my best skill match). No duplicates: Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Maya=ISSUE-0002::test, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::implement, Gerda=one ISSUE-0001 low task. Committing in execution.
